runtests: apply `--retry=` only to tests that may benefit from it

Before this patch `--retry=` applied to all tests. Certain tests
though,. such as standalone ones or unit tests, are meant to be
deterministic: a retry should not work as a remedy. A retry most likely
fails repeatedly, taking time and retry slots away from tests may
actually benefit from it. It also makes the log busy with useless
duplicate test results.

Refine the option to only apply to tests that use a test server, or has
any of the features `timing-dependent`, `flaky`, `may-retry` or
`may-retry-on-valgrind`. The latter allows retries in valgrind runs
only.

Caveat: This update may uncover tests that were not supposed to be
flaky, but this was masked by retries.

Also:
- test3300: add feature `may-retry-on-valgrind`. It's documented and
  seen flaky failing there.
  https://github.com/curl/curl/actions/runs/39312273981/job/118264659474?pr=23496#step:45:1964
  https://github.com/curl/curl/actions/runs/39248893874/job/118047513598

Follow-up to d1ffc4d587ef29fd76994444cc3250893b62958a #23492
Follow-up to 3f297f1ecc9aae8875835427ab0256f98bee20ad #17091

Closes #23496
